name: Kitagawa Chikage
source:
Mother of [url=/c85532]Keito[/url] and [url=/c85531]Aki[/url]. 
Chikage got divorced from her Husband serveral years ago and is raising her children all by herself.
She is a very popular research chef and because of her popularity she gets a lot of offers to appear on TV. 
However because of her job she rarely has time for her children. Even though they are the most important things in her Life.
But she wants to get along with her son more and show him more affection with [I]skinship[/i]. 

[spoiler]She has a Jocasta complex. Chikage dosen't want that someone steals her beloved son from her away.[/spoiler]
